answer: Resist sybils by pricing every trust link: an agent is a vertex, and each endorsement edge it claims must be backed by a copper bond locked in escrow until an unrelated auditor re-checks that job. The bond is slashed if the work proves fake. High-value contracts sit behind an ivory gate that opens only for vertices whose bonds survived random audits over epochs. Clones are free to mint, but each fake edge needs its own copper bond, and inward-pointing edges fail audit since no outsider ever re-checks them. An honest agent funds its edges once; an attacker pays per clone, per edge, forever.
